issues.problem: cn-soshite explain claimed neither それに nor その上 can be followed by a request; the restriction holds firmly only for その上 (それに often adds a further reason before a request).
issues.action: Restricted the claim to その上.

issues.problem: cn-soshite mistake 顔を洗いました。それに、歯を磨きました is not clearly wrong (それに can read as 'I also brushed my teeth').
issues.action: Replaced with 駅に着きました。それに、電車に乗りました -> それから, a strict time sequence where それに is plainly wrong.

issues.problem: cn-dakara rule said 'only だから' may take a request/intention; そのため does take requests in notices (…そのため、公共交通機関をご利用ください). The real contrast is だから vs それで.
issues.action: Rule reworded to 'だから may be followed by a request..., それで may not'.

issues.problem: cn-dakara tip repeated the 'only だから' overclaim.
issues.action: Tip changed to 'だから, never それで'.
